info.title: Sprint Connect API
info.description: Sprint Connect, the API for merchants of Sprint Africa. Create local shipments within Lagos and interstate shipments, request rate quotes, and read shipment events. Requests are authenticated with a bearer API key issued from the merchant portal.

Bearer.name: Authorization
Bearer.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.

post.description: Compute per-package prices for one pickup and multiple destinations across states. Returns a signed quote_id and per-package pricing. Pass the quote_id to POST /v1/interstate/bulk/shipments.

403.description: Merchant not enabled for parcel service.

404.description: Route not found for one or more packages.

post.description: Create a batch of interstate shipments from a signed bulk quote_id. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Debits the merchant's prepaid balance once for the batch total plus commission.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque string. Retries with the same key are safe.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.

post.description: Compute zone-based prices for one Lagos pickup and multiple Lagos dropoffs. Returns a signed quote_id and per-package pricing. Pass the quote_id to POST /v1/local/bulk/shipments.

403.description: Merchant not enabled for parcel service.

post.description: Create a batch of Lagos same-city shipments from a signed bulk local quote_id. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Debits the merchant's prepaid balance once for the batch total plus commission.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque string. Retries with the same key are safe.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.

post.description: Compute a zone-based price for a Lagos pickup and dropoff pair. Returns a signed quote_id that must be passed to POST /v1/local/shipments. No weight input — the local rate card is zone-based and the vehicle class is derived from package_type.

403.description: Merchant not enabled for parcel service.

post.description: Create a Lagos same-city shipment from a signed local quote_id. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Debits the merchant's prepaid balance atomically with order creation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque string. Retries with the same key are safe.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.

post.description: Compute a delivery fee for an interstate parcel. Returns a signed quote_id that must be passed to POST /v1/shipments. Quotes expire after 300 seconds.

403.description: Merchant not enabled for parcel service.

404.description: No route available for the state pair.

get.description: Return a cursor-paginated list of the merchant's shipments. The environment is derived from the API key: a test key sees only test shipments, a live key sees only live shipments.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Return rows created before this.

post.description: Create an interstate shipment for the merchant using a signed quote_id obtained from POST /v1/rates. The request must include an Idempotency-Key header. Repeating a request with the same key is safe and returns the original result; reusing the key with a different request body returns a conflict. The merchant's prepaid balance is debited atomically with shipment creation. The shipment is assigned to the environment of the authenticating API key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque string. Retries with the same key are safe.

409.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.

get.description: Return every shipment in a bulk batch, identified by batch_id. Scoped to the authenticated merchant. Batches created via bulk endpoints share a single batch_id; this endpoint returns all of them in one response without pagination.

404.description: No shipments found for this batch_id.

get.description: Retrieve all events that occurred after a cursor. Used to recover after a polling gap.

parameters.name: since_cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. Omit to start from the beginning.

get.description: Fetch a single shipment by tracking ID.
Chronological list of events for one shipment.
Public tracking lookup by tracking ID. Returns a rich, customer-facing view of the shipment: headline status, journey summary, and a personalised event timeline. No authentication required.

shared_pickup_fee.title: Shared pickup fee
shared_pickup_fee.description: Optional shared pickup fee, divided evenly across the batch. If omitted, the pricing engine's default bulk pickup fee is used.

merchant_reference.title: Merchant reference
merchant_reference.description: Per-package reference. Echoed back in the response for reconciliation.

shared_pickup_fee.title: Shared pickup fee
shared_pickup_fee.description: Optional fee divided evenly across the batch. If omitted, each package is priced at the zone-matrix rate with no extra pickup charge.

quote_id.title: Quote id
quote_id.description: Signed bulk local quote identifier. Pass this to POST /v1/local/bulk/shipments.

pickup_address.title: Pickup address
pickup_address.description: Full street address of the pickup location, in Lagos.

dropoff_address.title: Dropoff address
dropoff_address.description: Full street address of the dropoff location, in Lagos.

package_type.title: Package type
package_type.description: Drives the vehicle class for this delivery: document/small → bike, medium → car, large/custom → van.

quote_id.title: Quote id
quote_id.description: Signed local quote identifier. Pass this to POST /v1/local/shipments.

pickup_zone.title: Pickup zone
pickup_zone.description: Resolved zone for the pickup address (Z1–Z6).

dropoff_zone.title: Dropoff zone
dropoff_zone.description: Resolved zone for the dropoff address (Z1–Z6).

vehicle_type.title: Vehicle type
vehicle_type.description: Vehicle class derived from package_type: bike, car, or van.

issued_at.title: Issued at
issued_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the quote was issued.

expires_at.title: Expires at
expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the quote expires. Quote TTL is 300 seconds.

merchant_reference.title: Merchant reference
merchant_reference.description: The merchant's own order ID. Echoed back on every response.

quote_id.title: Quote id
quote_id.description: Signed quote identifier. Pass this to POST /v1/shipments.

issued_at.title: Issued at
issued_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the quote was issued.

expires_at.title: Expires at
expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the quote expires. Quote TTL is 300 seconds.

merchant_reference.title: Merchant reference
merchant_reference.description: The merchant's own order ID. Echoed back on every response and every event so the merchant can reconcile without a secondary lookup. Free-form; not unique-enforced.

batch_id.title: Batch id
batch_id.description: Bulk batch ID. Null for single shipments.

service_type.title: Service type
service_type.description: One of: interstate_single, interstate_bulk, local. Classifies the shipment for merchant-portal display.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: One of: test, live. Matches the API key environment that created the shipment.

balance_after.title: Balance after
balance_after.description: Merchant's balance after this operation. Only present on create.

event_id.title: Event id
event_id.description: Stable opaque identifier. Deduplicate on this value.

event_type.title: Event type
event_type.description: One of the EventType values, e.g. 'shipment.delivered'.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current shipment status at the moment of this event.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Opaque cursor. Pass as `since_cursor` to /v1/shipments/catchup to resume from this event.

eta_days.title: Eta days
eta_days.description: Estimated delivery days from creation. Null if unknown.

eta_label.title: Eta label
eta_label.description: Pre-formatted ETA, e.g. 'Arrives in 2 days' or 'Delivered on 25 Sep'. Empty when not applicable.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Optional second line of context. Empty when nothing applies.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Stable key the frontend maps to a visual.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: One-line summary the page can render as the main heading.
